description: Local-first Windows companion for Android phones with encrypted notifications, messages, calls, file transfer, and screen mirroring.
notes: Review status: the official v0.1.4 Windows x64 release asset and its SHA-256 digest are verified. The source identifies the setup as NSIS.

The vendor installer performs a machine-wide installation and configures Windows Firewall rules, a scheduled update task, an AppX sparse package, HKLM install/uninstall registration, and shortcuts. The application also has its own updater.

This manifest downloads the setup only; it does not run the vendor installer. Verify a Scoop-compatible install and complete uninstall flow before promotion. Windows ARM64 is not offered in this release.
